metadata.title: Retro Pop Portrait with Geometric Sans Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A close-up portrait featuring a subject with textured, wet-look hair and high-contrast lighting, overlaid with large-scale geometric sans-serif typography and a secondary pill-shaped text badge.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format portrait of a smiling woman with dark, curly, wet-look hair. She wears a black garment, and her hands are raised to her head. The lighting is dramatic, creating deep shadows and warm highlights. Large, thin-stroke geometric white text spans the top, with a smaller orange pill-shaped badge containing secondary text centered within the larger letters.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography overlaps the subject's hair and hands at the top edge
The pill-shaped badge is nested inside the circular counter of a large letter
High-contrast lighting on the face balances the dark negative space of the clothing
The subject's upward arm movement frames the central facial features
coreInvariants: Large-scale geometric sans-serif display type at the top margin
Pill-shaped orange badge for secondary information

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up head and shoulders portrait, centered, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the large white text above.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large white typography, moves down the arms to the face, and rests on the central smile.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space provided by the subject's clothing at the bottom and the dark background behind the hair.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text and dark background; warm, saturated skin tones against neutral blacks.

letterConstructionRules: High cap height spanning the width of the frame
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' is oversized to accommodate the secondary badge

composition.position: Centered inside the 'O' of the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large geometric display type paired with a smaller, condensed sans-serif contained within a graphic shape.

preserve: Thin stroke weight of the main title
avoid: Heavy bold weights for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and sharp vertices of the 70s era.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and thin stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square portrait of a woman with dark, wet-look curly hair, smiling, with hands raised to her head, wearing a black V-neck top against a dark, textured studio background with warm lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large white geometric sans-serif text across the top. Inside the circular counter of the 'O', place a small orange pill-shaped badge with white condensed sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the orange badge centered within the 'O'?
Is the main text white and thin-stroked?
Does the text overlap the subject's hair?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Yvonne Elliman'
Do not replicate the exact RSO Records logo style if present
Ensure the face is a generic likeness, not a specific celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the hair
Ensure the orange badge is a solid, vibrant color
Verify the geometric sharpness of the letter 'V' and 'N'
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Geometric Sans Overlay + Nested Badge
